newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain prime minister returns home.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain prime minister returns home.

text.p: Bahrain's Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa returned to the Gulf Arab state on Sunday from a private visit abroad, the official Gulf News Agency said.

Sheikh Khalifa, prime minister since Bahrain's independence from Britain in 1971, left the smallest and least wealthy of the six oil-rich Gulf Arab monarchies and emirates in early December on what was officially described as a private visit.
Sources in Bahrain had said the prime minister, who suffered heart attacks in 1985 and 1988, had visited Europe, Malaysia, the Philippines and the Maldives.
